name: Genghe
description: A naked-eye star 15.8 parsecs away, 1.4 times the Sun's width: its disc was measured with the CHARA Array.

radius.source: Boyajian et al. (2012), ApJ 746, 101, HD 128167: radius in solar radii, from the limb-darkened angular diameter 0.841 +/- 0.013 mas (CHARA) and the Hipparcos parallax, 1.431 +/- 0.023

mass.source: Boyajian et al. (2012), ApJ 746, 101, HD 128167: mass in solar masses, from Yonsei-Yale isochrones at the measured radius and temperature (a model value), 1.194 +/- 0.013

temperature.source: Boyajian et al. (2012), ApJ 746, 101, HD 128167: effective temperature in K, from the angular diameter and the bolometric flux, 6594 +/- 55

distance.source: Boyajian et al. (2012), ApJ 746, 101, HD 128167: the Hipparcos parallax the radius was computed with (van Leeuwen 2007), 63.16 +/- 0.26 mas, inverted

text.card: A naked-eye star 16 parsecs away whose disc the CHARA Array measured: 1.4 times the Sun's width.
text.introduction: Its disc spans 0.841 milliarcseconds, which gives 1.431 solar radii and 6,594 K at its surface.
text.locator: Tables 5 and 10, HD 128167: limb-darkened diameter, R, Teff
